name: default-data-loading
summary: Fixed initializeDefaultData fetch path from /lib/storage/default-data.json to /default-data.json, and copied default data to public/ so Next.js serves it as a static asset.
completed_work: Analyzed the root cause: Next.js only serves files under public/ as static assets. The fetch('/lib/storage/default-data.json') call would fail in browser because lib/ is not a public route.
Copied lib/storage/default-data.json to public/default-data.json preserving exact JSON shape.
Changed fetch path in initializeDefaultData() from '/lib/storage/default-data.json' to '/default-data.json'.
Existing guard logic (checks documentTypeStorage and commonReviewItemStorage length > 0) unchanged — prevents overwriting existing user data.
Fallback error handling (console.error + early return) unchanged — empty state avoided on fetch failure.
decisions: Kept default-data.json in lib/storage/ as well (not deleted) to avoid breaking any other potential references. Only the public/ copy is the active serving path now.
Did not inline the JSON data into the TypeScript source — kept the fetch approach for consistency with the existing data-loading pattern.

contract_surface_for_step2.initializeDefaultData: Fetches /default-data.json. Guards against re-initialization if data already exists in localStorage. Exported from lib/storage/local-storage.ts.
contract_surface_for_step2.documentTypeStorage: CRUD for DocumentType[] in localStorage key draftreviewr:document-types. getAll() returns []. Used by app/page.tsx and admin page.
contract_surface_for_step2.commonReviewItemStorage: CRUD for CommonReviewItem[] in localStorage key draftreviewr:common-review-items. getAll() returns []. Used by admin pages.
contract_surface_for_step2.default-data shape: public/default-data.json contains document_types (1 item: 표준초안), common_review_items (3 items: 문서 형식 검토, 맞춤법 및 문법, 용어 일관성), review_items (empty).

verification: npm run build --prefix projects/DraftReviewr → passed (Next.js 15.2.4, all routes static)
next_actions: Run Step 2 (review-failure-state): add failed status update in DocumentUploadSection when OpenAI processing throws.
resume_hint: Step 1 complete. Default data now served from public/default-data.json. Proceed to step 2: review-failure-state.
